Isaac Placed Scenes

Every scene of benchmark_scenarios_full.yaml at its placement dx in Isaac Sim 6.1, furnished with the lab background. Left: the robot's camera_0 colour image (640×480) during the capture window, after the scene passed its state check. Right: a fixed orthographic overview camera over the whole room, read after the same render update as the robot image. Chips give the placement, the anchor's backdrop prop and gap, and the props the scene drops.

  • Visual review, not estimator qualification. These are pictures of the scenes; no score here says anything about an estimator.
  • Provenance. Captured 2026-11-02 from 14:23 through the normal benchmark runner (backend:=isaac background:=lab estimators:=pointcloud repeats:=1 capture_sec:=3.0 sim_mode:=deterministic headless:=false depth_fidelity:=ideal), all 109 trials passing the state check. Revision 3435eec plus the placement work then uncommitted, since committed as 8698008, c50da72 and 517817c, and the overview-capture hooks, which are not in the repository. The layout and drop file are byte-identical to the committed ones (SHA-256 4d445c3c… and 6942df0f…), so every scene places and furnishes exactly as shown.
  • The renderers differ. Lighting, materials and shading are Isaac's own; the geometry, placements and props are the same as in Gazebo. Compare with the Gazebo gallery.
  • Near field. Three scenes keep a prop close in front of the camera, which no drop rule covers: edge_sliver_01 (c_chair_b, 0.80 m), objpartial_05 (c_bin, 1.19 m) and interocc_neartotal_01 (c_bin, 1.26 m).
  • Images are re-encoded for this page; the overview is downscaled from 1280×800.
